gaps.detail: Twelve distinct named graduate degree candidates, all Northeastern University. This is not twelve universities. No portal extraction or human-approval labels used.
Research checked 2026-11-05 UTC. Northeastern source heading: '2026-2027 Tuition and Fees'. Publication/update date not stated.
Original '$' symbol preserved in tuition values. Explicit ISO currency code was not established by the returned page excerpts; no currency conversion performed.

General graduate tuition schedule, not an explicitly international-only schedule. International-specific applicability remains unverified for each course. Canadian campus fees link elsewhere. Online programs must not be treated as evidence of F-1 visa eligibility.
Required degree credits, total degree tuition, ancillary fees and international insurance costs remain unverified. Per-credit figures are not annual or full-degree prices.

gaps.detail: Fetched College of Professional Studies English policy is not applicable evidence for degrees in other colleges; no English minima transferred to these twelve candidates.
Campuses, duration, intakes, entry qualifications and English requirements are unverified unless separately represented by a verified field. No seasonal intake conversions performed.
Official note: 'Please note, courses taken outside of your home college may be billed at the per credit rate of the college offering the course.' Program labels and college context must be retained.

Finance page contains both current and archived tables. An initial fetch summary incorrectly pulled MS Exercise Science from 2025-2026 and gave a different Health Informatics rate. Targeted exact-row queries corrected these; neither is included among candidates. This is a retrieval-summary error, not a claimed contradiction between official policies.
Northeastern catalog URL fetch failed HTTP 429. No bypass was attempted. Its search snippet is supplemental only; all candidate values rely on the separately surfaced student-finance page.
